thesis: Computational description, computational dynamics and external implementation are separate simulation claims.
role: Clarify conditional observer counting and ordinary reality within a simulation.

ideas.statement: Simulation differs from computational description and can coexist with emergence; substrate alone does not establish author, purpose or intervention.
Bostrom's conditional alternatives require consciousness, resource and observer-sampling assumptions; arithmetic alone cannot establish our probability.
A simulated world can retain real causal relations for inhabitants, while empirical status requires a precise version with different observable consequences.
